caption: Product Analytics on our development store: with no unit cost in Shopify, cost price shows Not set and gross margin N/A, so we never saw a real margin. The store name is hidden.
Same warning on a $2,629.95 snowboard with 20 in stock: stock value and margin stay N/A until you add a cost price. Without recent sales the restock advice reads 0 units. The store name is hidden.

Free covers analytics, cost price and margin, units sold over 30/90/365 days and restock advice. Editing, SEO fields and the activity log need Pro at $29 a month. The vendor contact address and store name are hidden.
Shopify's plan screen on a development store offers only Free to test. Paid plans sit under Unavailable on dev stores, so we could not try Pro. The store name is hidden.
The Pro card ($29 every 30 days, 14 trial days) stays greyed out with Not available, so we never reached an approval screen or saw a total. The store name is hidden.
